method: Seeded random sample (eval/audit_sample.ts, seed 7). Judges were separate model agents given only the catalog and cards that omit our scores and reasoning. Precision: 100 emitted edges, each judged once by a neutral judge and once by a skeptical judge (whose brief was to find edges that would mislead an agent). Recall: 60 required inputs stratified by how the matcher treated them (40% with edges, 30% considered but no edge, 30% excluded by a rule), judged without seeing any of our edges.
caveats: Judges share a model family with the author of the matcher, so errors may correlate. Sample sizes give roughly +/-8 points of uncertainty on precision. Labels are opinions about API semantics, not ground truth.
